meta.title: Commander Mode
meta.description: You judge and coordinate; subagents execute. Ships with six built-in specialists (architecture, implementation, review, testing, security, docs) that you can reshape or bind to their own models.

settings.title: Commander specialists
settings.description: You decide, subagents do the work. Ships with six built-in specialists (architecture, implementation, review, testing, security, docs); add, remove, or bind each to its own model.
settings.intro: Click a row to edit it. Restore brings back the six built-in specialists (draft only — press Save to apply). The roster applies to new sessions; the one you have open keeps what it started with.
settings.empty: The commander can still delegate through Agent Teams. Add a specialist here to give a role its own prompt and, if you want, its own model.
settings.addHint: Append an empty specialist row and expand it for editing.
settings.removeHint: Remove this specialist from the draft. Press Save to apply it.
settings.resetHint: Restore only rewrites the draft with the six built-in specialists; nothing is saved until you press Save.
settings.resetDone: Built-in roster restored in the draft. Review it, then press Save.
settings.savingFailed: The deployment did not accept this roster; your edits were kept for you to correct.
settings.savedHint: Roster saved. New sessions get the updated specialist tools; the current session keeps the roster it started with.
settings.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so its roster cannot be configured right now.
settings.hintId: Lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_"; starts with a letter, max 48 chars. Becomes part of the tool name.
settings.hintProvider: Provider id registered here (e.g. deepseek). Leave both blank to inherit the commander model.
settings.hintModel: Model id this specialist runs on. Fill provider and model together, or leave both blank.
settings.hintDescription: What this specialist is responsible for; the commander sees this when it picks someone.
settings.hintPersona: Extra system-prompt text. Leave blank to derive it from the responsibility.
settings.hintReasoningEffort: Leave blank to use the model default.
settings.hintMaxTokens: A positive integer; blank uses the model default.
settings.duplicateId: row {row}: the id "{id}" is used twice
settings.partialRoute: row {row}: fill both provider and model, or leave both blank to inherit the commander model
settings.invalidMaxTokens: row {row}: max output tokens must be a positive integer
settings.summaryInheritedHint: Uses the commander (parent session) model. Fill provider and model to give it its own.
settings.summaryOwnRouteHint: Uses its own provider/model route for every child it starts.
